text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Author(y, x) ::: y is the author of x.
FamilyHistory(x) ::: x is Family History.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
WrittenIn(x, y) ::: x is written in year y.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Uncertain ::: the truth value is uncertain.

Premises:
¬Podcast(FamilyHistory) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornIn(x, AmericanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, then the person is American.
∀x ∀y ((Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y)) → (Writer(y))) ::: If a book is a novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is American.
WrittenBy(FamilyHistory, DaniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
WrittenIn(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is written in 2003.
Created(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(Boston) ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
Writer(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
